title: CEO若突然缺位：英伟达被指无成文继任安排，若真出事，谁能临时接管？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Boards are supposed to oversee what's going on with the executives.
segments.zh: 董事会本应监督高管的动向。

segments.en: There's always this idea that a CEO could be gone for whatever reason, whether it's through malfeasance, whether it's through health issues, or maybe they just want to do something else.
segments.zh: 总有一种观点认为，CEO可能因各种原因离职，无论是由于不当行为、健康问题，还是可能他们只是想做别的事情。

segments.en: Shouldn't have Nvidia have had a more coherent and more publicly articulated succession plan.
segments.zh: 英伟达是否应该有一个更连贯、更公开阐述的继任计划？

segments.en: Certainly, that's a very important responsibility of the board.
segments.zh: 当然，这是董事会非常重要的职责。

segments.en: You always should be thinking down the road what could happen if.
segments.zh: 你总是应该思考未来可能发生什么。

segments.en: This was an unusual one, in that you couldn't really forecast something like this happening.
segments.zh: 这次情况不寻常，因为你真的无法预测这种事情的发生。

segments.en: On the other hand, whether it's illness, retirement, change of job, change of psyche, you have to think about who's coming next.
segments.zh: 另一方面，无论是疾病、退休、换工作、心态变化，你都必须考虑下一个是谁。

segments.en: And the fact that there was apparently no firm plan in place is troubling, because that's what a board is supposed to be doing.
segments.zh: 而事实上显然没有固定的计划，这令人不安，因为这本应是董事会的职责。

segments.en: It's not that we have the new leader ready to go, it's that if something happens, if he gets hit by a bus or who knows, that we have someone who can basically run the store until we can figure it out.
segments.zh: 并不是说我们已经有了准备就绪的新领导人，而是说如果发生什么事，比如他被公交车撞了或者谁知道呢，我们得有个人能基本维持运营，直到我们弄清楚情况。

segments.en: And that was missing here, and that explained the confusion earlier this week.
segments.zh: 而这一点在这里是缺失的，这就解释了本周早些时候的混乱。

segments.en: Well, I am curious too. I mean, you've sat on boards in the past, and correct and find it wrong, but I believe you're on the board at Sunbeam.
segments.zh: 我也很好奇。你过去担任过董事，纠正错误，但我记得你在Sunbeam的董事会。

segments.en: I was done lap famous, changed all out. Yes, yes.
segments.zh: 我完成了著名的圈数，改变了所有。是的，是的。

segments.en: I was out. So obviously, a little bit of a different story than what's going on within Nvidia.
segments.zh: 我出局了。显然，与英伟达的情况有些不同。

segments.en: I had to make the motion for this termination. Well, can you tell me a little bit about that process?
segments.zh: 我必须提出终止的动议。你能告诉我一些关于那个过程吗？
